Title: Lines per level
Description: 10 cleared lines are required to advance one level

Title: Single line clear
Description: Locking with exactly one full row removes it and shifts rows above down by one

Title: Double line clear
Description: Locking with exactly two full rows clears both in a single step

Title: Triple line clear
Description: Locking with exactly three full rows clears all three in a single step

Title: Tetris (quad) clear
Description: Locking with exactly four full rows clears all four in a single step

Title: Non-contiguous clears preserve gaps
Description: Only filled rows are removed and remaining blocks settle preserving partial-row gaps

Title: No false clear
Description: A row containing any empty cell is never cleared

Title: Collision integrity invariant
Description: No active-piece cell ever overlaps an occupied cell or exits left/right/bottom bounds

Title: Keyboard bindings
Description: Bindings: arrows move/soft-drop, Space hard-drop, Up/X & Z/Ctrl rotate, C/Shift hold, Esc/P pause, R restart

Title: Deterministic repeat / simultaneous keys
Description: Key repeat has no missed/doubled inputs; simultaneous keys resolve deterministically

Title: Suppress browser default gestures
Description: Arrows/Space do not scroll the page and touch gestures do not zoom during play

Title: Input spam safe
Description: Many inputs within one frame cause no crash/illegal state/double-move; invariants hold

Title: Concurrent rotate+move+drop deterministic
Description: Simultaneous rotate/move/drop resolve deterministically without overlap or escaping bounds

Title: Hard drop into full column
Description: Hard drop into a full/near-full column locks correctly at top (may game over) without crashing

Title: localStorage unavailable degrades
Description: If localStorage is unavailable/quota/private (persistence degrades gracefully and game stays playable)

Title: Ghost piece matches landing
Description: Ghost piece marks the exact cells where a hard drop would land the active piece

Title: Playfield dimensions
Description: Playfield is 10 cells wide and 20 cells high

Title: Cell state
Description: Each cell is either empty or filled with exactly one piece color/type id

Title: Level increases every 10 lines
Description: Level increments by one each time cumulative cleared lines cross the next multiple of 10

Title: Start spawns first piece + gravity
Description: Triggering Start spawns the first tetromino top-center and begins the gravity timer

Title: Pause stops fall and timer
Description: Pausing stops the active piece from falling and stops the gravity timer

Title: Pause ignores gameplay input
Description: While paused all input except Resume is ignored; board state does not change

Title: Resume restores identical state
Description: Resuming continues from the identical board/piece/score/level/lines state before pausing

Title: Restart resets state
Description: Restart after game over resets board/score/level/lines to initial values and starts fresh

Title: Tab blur auto-pause
Description: On tab blur/refocus exactly one loop runs with no runaway timers or skipped-tick avalanche

Title: Lock on landing and spawn next
Description: When the piece can no longer move down it locks into the board and a new piece spawns

Title: Bounded lock delay
Description: Movement/rotation allowed during a bounded ~500 ms lock delay without indefinite stalling

Title: Horizontal move by one column
Description: Left/Right moves the piece exactly one column if target cells are empty and in bounds

Title: Blocked horizontal move rejected
Description: A move crossing the boundary or overlapping a locked cell is rejected; piece unchanged

Title: Automatic gravity descent
Description: Active piece descends one cell automatically every gravity tick while running

Title: Soft drop accelerates descent
Description: Holding Soft Drop makes the piece descend faster than normal gravity

Title: Hard drop locks instantly
Description: Hard Drop instantly moves the piece to its landing position and locks it

Title: Block-out ends game
Description: A newly spawned piece colliding immediately sets status to gameover and stops gravity

Title: Game-over screen w/ score + restart
Description: Game-over screen shows the final score and a Restart control

Title: No board mutation after game over
Description: Gameplay input that would mutate the board is ignored in game-over state (no zombie moves)

Title: No spawn after game over until restart
Description: No new piece spawns in game-over state until the user restarts

Title: Seven tetrominoes exist
Description: The seven standard tetrominoes I/O/T/S/Z/L/J exist with correct geometry

Title: Standard colors
Description: Pieces use standard colors: I cyan O yellow T purple S green Z red L orange J blue

Title: Four cells per piece
Description: Every tetromino is composed of exactly four cells in any rotation

Title: Spawn position centered at top
Description: Spawns at top horizontally centered via x = floor(fieldWidth/2) - floor(pieceWidth/2) in standard orientation

Title: Rotate 90 about pivot
Description: Rotation turns the piece 90 degrees in the requested direction about its pivot

Title: SRS wall kicks
Description: On collision rotation applies the first valid SRS kick-table offset that fits

Title: Impossible rotation rejected
Description: If rotation collides and no valid kick exists the rotation is rejected; piece unchanged

Title: Score monotonic and non-negative
Description: Score is monotonically non-decreasing and never negative

Title: Line-clear scoring scale
Description: Awards 100/300/500/800 x level for 1/2/3/4 lines cleared

Title: Lines counter increments exactly
Description: Lines-cleared counter increases by exactly the number of rows cleared on a lock

Title: Soft/hard drop points
Description: Awards 1 point per cell soft-dropped and 2 points per cell hard-dropped

Title: High score persists across reloads
Description: High score persists via localStorage and is restored after a page reload

Title: 7-bag randomizer
Description: Spawn order uses a 7-bag randomizer so each piece appears once per bag (no dup/starve)

Title: Next preview matches spawn
Description: The Next preview piece matches the actual next spawned piece

Title: Hold swap once per piece
Description: Hold swaps active and held piece at most once per piece until it locks

Title: Static HTTPS hosting
Description: Runs over plain HTTPS with no server-side runtime dependency (static-hosting compatible)

Title: HUD shows/updates score/level/lines
Description: HUD always shows score/level/lines and updates immediately when they change

Title: Side panel content
Description: Side panel shows score, level, lines, Next preview, New Game/Restart, and Game Over indicator
